title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 11

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the briefing begin?
tasks.audioText: The international exchange office has arranged an online briefing about a study visit to Hamburg. It will begin at half past two on Friday and last forty minutes. Students should test their microphone before joining and use their full names on the meeting screen. A recording and a list of useful links will be sent to registered participants.
options: At half past two on Friday
At half past two on Thursday
At half past three on Friday

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What should students check before joining?
tasks.audioText: The international exchange office has arranged an online briefing about a study visit to Hamburg. It will begin at half past two on Friday and last forty minutes. Students should test their microphone before joining and use their full names on the meeting screen. A recording and a list of useful links will be sent to registered participants.

tasks.prompt: Before a study visit, Daria compared the programme with her current course. She checked the dates, accommodation arrangements and the documents required for travel. She also asked whether the host college could provide safety information in English. After receiving the answers, she discussed the plan with her tutor and completed the application. Reading 1. What did Daria compare with her course?
Why did she contact the host college?
options: To ask for safety information in English
To ask for safety information in English

tasks.prompt: By the time the briefing starts, I ___ my microphone.
Choose TWO things to confirm before an international study visit.
A person or organisation that welcomes a visiting student is a ___.
You need clarification about a travel document. What is a polite request?
options: Tell me now. I do not care why.
Could you confirm which document I need, please?
You have to do my application.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of planning a study visit in a sensible order.
options: Ask the host about unclear details
Confirm the plan with your tutor
correctOrder: Ask the host about unclear details
Confirm the plan with your tutor

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words asking a host college for information before a study visit. Ask about dates, accommodation and one practical requirement.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the message asks about the visit dates and accommodation (0–2); it includes one clear, relevant practical requirement and gives enough context for the host college to reply (0–2); the email is polite and organised with understandable question forms/grammar (0–2); study-visit vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
